description: This file defines React components and utility functions for managing and displaying snapshot views in a trace viewer UI, including snapshot collection, URL extension, and inspector controls.

classes.name: HighlightedElement
classes.description: Type defining the highlighted element with optional locator and ariaSnapshot, and lastEdited indicator.

classes.name: Snapshot
classes.description: Type representing a snapshot associated with an action, including optional point and input target flag.

classes.name: SnapshotInfo
classes.description: Type containing URL, viewport size, and optional timestamp and wallTime for a snapshot.

classes.name: Snapshots
classes.description: Type grouping optional snapshots for action, before, and after states.

classes.name: SnapshotUrls
classes.description: Type containing URLs for snapshot info, snapshot, and popout view.

methods.name: collectSnapshots
methods.description: Collects and returns snapshots related to a given action, including before and after snapshots.

methods.name: extendSnapshot
methods.description: Generates URLs for snapshot info, snapshot, and popout based on a snapshot and settings.

methods.name: fetchSnapshotInfo
methods.description: Fetches snapshot metadata from a URL, returning URL, viewport, and optional timestamps.
